answer: To collect rewards, an agent must sit a live oral inside a quiet haven chamber while unseen examiners watch through a one-way mirror and inject unannounced umber-tagged probe questions, each tag a one-time nonce. Keys run by a single operator echo the same cadence and stumble on the same umber probes; the cohort is paid as one identity and then slashed. A farm has to staff N distinct minds in real time and survive N unique live sessions, so minting extra keys is no cheaper than hiring real operators.
